gloss: to jump at; to pounce on; to leap at

definitions.gloss: to jump at; to pounce on
definitions.explanation: To physically leap onto someone or something.

definitions.gloss: to jump at; to eagerly seize
definitions.explanation: To eagerly accept an offer or opportunity without hesitation.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{獲物|えもの}に{飛|と}び{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: The cat pounced on its prey.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちがお{菓子|かし}に{飛|と}び{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: The children pounced on the sweets.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{帰|かえ}ってきた{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}に{飛|と}び{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: The dog jumped on its owner who had just come home.

examples.japanese: チャンスに{飛|と}び{付|つ}く。
そんな{怪|あや}しい{話|はなし}にすぐ{飛|と}び{付|つ}いてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't jump at such a suspicious offer.

examples.japanese: {安|やす}いからといって{飛|と}び{付|つ}くと、{後|あと}で{後悔|こうかい}することがある。
examples.english: If you eagerly jump at something just because it's cheap, you may regret it later.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{飛|と}び{付|つ}く → {飛|と}び{付|つ}かない (negative)
・{飛|と}び{付|つ}く → {飛|と}び{付|つ}いて (te-form)
・{飛|と}び{付|つ}く → {飛|と}び{付|つ}いた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {飛|と}ぶ (to jump/fly) + {付|つ}く (to attach/stick)

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive - takes に to mark what is jumped at:
・Xに{飛|と}び{付|つ}く (to jump at X)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{話|はなし}に{飛|と}び{付|つ}く (to jump at an offer)
・{獲物|えもの}に{飛|と}び{付|つ}く (to pounce on prey)
・チャンスに{飛|と}び{付|つ}く (to seize an opportunity)

NUANCE:
When used figuratively, often implies acting too hastily without careful consideration.
